descriptionEn:
Question on § “Relative atomic mass of a chemical element” (Kimyo, grade 7).

Formulation: On what fact is the correct conclusion based on the topic “Relative atomic mass of a chemical”?

Correct answer: Type of atoms with the same nuclear charge (number of protons).

Element = atoms with the same Z (number of protons).

Paragraph material (support for answer):

1. The relative atomic mass of an element is a physical quantity that shows how many times the mass of an atom of a chemical element is greater than 1/12 the mass of a carbon atom.

2. An atomic mass unit is 1/12 of the mass of a carbon atom, which is 1.66 • 10-27 kg.

3. Atomic mass—the average mass of isotopes of a given element.

4. Relative atomic mass

Remember: the answer must match the wording of the textbook. After choosing an option, check yourself again using the text §.
descriptionUz:
§ “Kimyoviy elementning nisbiy atom massasi” bo‘yicha savol (Kimyo, 7-sinf).

Formula: “Kimyoviy moddaning nisbiy atom massasi” mavzusiga asoslangan to‘g‘ri xulosa qaysi faktga asoslanadi?

To'g'ri javob: Yadro zaryadi bir xil bo'lgan atomlar turi (protonlar soni).

Element = bir xil Z bo'lgan atomlar (protonlar soni).

Paragraf materiali (javobni qo'llab-quvvatlash):

1. Elementning nisbiy atom massasi - bu kimyoviy element atomining massasi uglerod atomi massasining 1/12 qismidan necha marta katta ekanligini ko'rsatadigan fizik miqdor.

2. Atom massa birligi uglerod atomi massasining 1/12 qismini tashkil qiladi, bu 1,66 • 10-27 kg.

3. Atom massasi-ma'lum element izotoplarining o'rtacha massasi.

4. Nisbiy atom massasi

Esingizda bo'lsin: javob darslik matniga mos kelishi kerak. Variantni tanlagandan so'ng, § matni yordamida o'zingizni yana tekshiring.
explanationEn: Element = atoms with the same Z (number of protons).
explanationUz: Element = bir xil Z bo'lgan atomlar (protonlar soni).
